name: deep-research
description: Education and research skills for deep research, literature review, academic writing, peer review, and research pipelines.

interface.shortDescription: 用于文献综述、学术写作、评审与实验的研究工作流。
interface.longDescription: Deep Research packages Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex as a single Codex-native academic-research-suite skill. It routes research tasks across deep research, literature review, systematic review, academic paper drafting and revision, manuscript review, end-to-end research-to-paper pipelines, experiment planning, statistical interpretation, and reproducibility checks while preserving the upstream ARS resources.
defaultPrompt: Use academic-research-suite to scope a research question and build a literature review.
Use academic-research-suite to review this manuscript and draft a decision letter.
Use academic-research-suite to plan an end-to-end research-to-paper pipeline.
